name: What maintenance is required for skylights after installation?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for skylights after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern skylights are designed for minimal maintenance, primarily requiring periodic cleaning of the glass to ensure optimal light transmission. It's also advisable to inspect the flashing around the skylight annually for any signs of wear or damage, especially after severe weather, to prevent leaks. As part of our commitment to homeowner experience, AKN Design Group ensures quality installation that minimizes future maintenance concerns, emphasizing proper sealing and material selection for long-term durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Skylights need periodic glass cleaning and annual flashing inspections for wear or damage. Our quality installation minimizes future maintenance concerns.
